{{Top|leg}}
The '''Droid carbonite projector''' was an improvised [[Droid/Legends|droid]] weapon that had been originally designed for freezing perishable goods for the purpose of long term storage. Its use against [[Human/Legends|Humans]] appeared to be particularly effective.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.

*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
